name: gzh-content-ops
description: Private WeChat Official Account content-ops expert team: AI-persona positioning, a 7-agent pipeline (topic scouting to draft-box + video-account adaptation), 16 themes x 8 layouts, zero-credit Gemini imagery, serialized column templates, AI-taste <=20, compliance gate & review loop.

displayDescription.en: Your private Official Account expert team: a 7-agent pipeline covering topic scouting, drafting, zero-credit Gemini imagery, layout, draft-box delivery and video-account scripts.
displayDescription.zh: 你独用的公众号内容运营专家团：7角色流水线跑选题、写稿、零积分配图、排版、草稿箱，并适配视频号。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用今天的一个AI话题，帮我跑一篇公众号草稿（含选题、封面配图、排版候选，进草稿箱，并附视频号脚本）。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Use today's AI topic to run a full Official Account draft (topic, hook, sections, punchline, covers, layout options) into the draft box, plus a video-account script.

quickPrompts.en: Use today's AI topic to run a full Official Account draft (topic, hook, sections, punchline, covers, layout options) into the draft box, plus a video-account script.

quickPrompts.en: Give me 3 layout options (theme x format) for this piece before rendering, and pick the palette and format by topic.
quickPrompts.zh: 这篇先给我出3套排版候选（主题×版式）再渲染，按题材帮我选配色和版式。

quickPrompts.en: Run today's market recap as the 'A-Share Jianghu' serialized column, with Gemini zero-credit imagery.
